text:
I did not have this face of today,

so calm, so sad, so thin,

nor these eyes so empty,

nor this bitter lip.


I did not have these strengthless hands,

so still and cold and dead;

I did not have this heart

that does not even show itself.


I did not notice this change,

so simple, so certain, so easy:

In what mirror was

my image lost?

translation.title: Portrait
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the famous self-portrait's quiet shock before aging and estrangement from one's own image.
